data.body:
LANDED. Gerrit change 1808 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1808) submitted and MERGED to main at LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1.

Authoritative green run: 4 local live runs against real Cloud REB+DIG over the S3 store backend, all 7 scenarios passing (latest strengthened-oracle run: 7 passed, ~20m). Evidence proving the five validations + zero Jira writes:
- Many-to-many: one S3 store maps BOTH REB and DIG via bridge_projects_set; inbound reconcile pulled the full real volume (2160 issues in snapshot: REB ~1126 + DIG ~1034) with correct per-project bridge_project attribution.
- bridge_preview over the multi-project mapping is read-only + per-project scoped (no cross-project contamination), Mode.DRY_RUN.
- S3 round-trip: git-remote-s3 push then clone round-trips with projects.json mapping intact (DIG, REB).
- ZERO Jira mutations: outbound_differ total=0 create=0 update=0 delete=0; per-project before/after issue counts identical (count oracle now uses true totals, max_results=10**9); unknown-project REBGHOST correctly FAILS CLOSED.
- Structural read-only guard: readonly_jira_guard autouse fixture patches all 18 mutating AcliClient methods to raise JiraWriteForbidden; test_read_only_guard_is_real asserts it fires.

CI: the added jira-cloud-s3-rehearsal job runs the suite gated on REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 + AWS_S3_REHEARSAL_ROLE_ARN; --ignore added to both external lanes to avoid double-collection. Verified gate passed after clearing a pre-existing intermittent macOS cleanup-step infra flake (filed as actinium-civic-needletail, linked discovered_from).

Cleanup: throwaway S3 prefix swept by fixture teardown (confirmed empty); scratch run logs removed from the worktree.
